entities.summary: Rajang Mangroves National Park is a designated wetland area situated along the lower reaches of the Rajang River in Sarawak. It encompasses extensive mangrove swamps that provide critical habitat for a range of species, including estuarine crocodiles, proboscis monkeys, and various migratory birds. The park plays a role in maintaining the ecological balance of the coastal and riverine environment in this part of Borneo.
